resources.string: Never: keep my bitrate can freeze or break up the picture on a link that cannot carry it, and works only with a PC that accepts bitrate changes; choose it when the picture turns soft on a link that can carry more. By default the PC lowers the bitrate when frames are lost that it cannot repair and raises it again afterwards; Lower it sooner lowers it earlier, with a softer picture as the cost.

What the controller’s or handheld’s Back button does: Back reaches the PC as Back, Control Center opens the Control Center, Guide sends Guide (Home or PS) to the PC. Leave it on Back if your games use that button.

Alt+Tab, the Windows key and similar go to the PC instead of this device, where Android allows it; In full screen keeps them here while the stream is in a window. Choose Off to keep those shortcuts on this device.

The stream moves to the new address when this device switches networks, instead of waiting for the old one; Any network also moves it onto mobile data or another metered network, which uses a lot of data. Leave it on Except mobile data; needs PC support.
